label: Darwinian epistemic debunking finite controls
meaning: Nonvacuity and omission controls for the three arguments. Tracking failure is separate from actual inaccuracy; origin information alone gives no tracking failure; the realist self-application premises are jointly satisfiable and leave the conclusion true and F6 intact; an antirealist debunker who accepts the same uniform policy keeps warrant. These are formal interpretations only; no actual history, reliability or account of epistemic correctness is established.
